paraphrases.subject: The integration broke when its private value changed

paraphrases.subject: Every delivery is marked invalid
paraphrases.description: Our listener still receives traffic, but the authenticity test fails across the board following a credential change on the provider side.

paraphrases.subject: Event signatures stopped matching
paraphrases.description: A new shared secret was deployed and now the digest calculated by our webhook consumer differs from the sender's digest.

paraphrases.subject: Automations are silent after a connector credential update
paraphrases.description: The provider reports successful deliveries while our endpoint refuses them because the attached proof no longer validates.

paraphrases.subject: Inbound integration traffic is being refused
paraphrases.description: The only recent change was replacing the secret used by the event source; every callback is now rejected as unauthenticated.

paraphrases.subject: Our callback trust check failed overnight
paraphrases.description: After the partner refreshed its private signing value, none of the event messages pass the receiver's authenticity check.
